thread:
incident-bot: PAGED @amy_oncall — streaming GPU pool `decode-eu-03` reporting repeated CUDA OOMs, container restarts, and ~25% request drops in last 6m. Auto-escalation: severity=P2.
amy_oncall: I'm on it. Observed high tail token counts for a small subset (~0.7%) of requests.
raj_eng: seeing similar in TRACE: clients sending `max_tokens: 10000` header while model config caps at 2048. Router batch policy tried to coalesce long sequences -> huge kv cache allocations.
maria_sre: logs look like kernel OOM then container restart loop. Stack: `libcuda -> cuMemAlloc -> cudaErrorMemoryAllocation`.
leo_runtime: suspect batching policy mismatch + disabled per-request token clamp in router. Rolling throttle flagged but not applied because header precedence wins.
amy_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary per-request token clamp at edge (router) 2) shift traffic off decode-eu-03 to standby pool 3) enable request-level drop/throttle for suspicious clients 4) customer impact comms.
ops-bot: Running command: ``/router clamp set --max-tokens=4096 --scope=global --reason="OOM mitigation"``
ops-bot: Response: accepted, change id `chg-20260317-01`, applying to all EU edge routers.
raj_eng: rolling traffic off node pool: ``/orchestrator migrate --from decode-eu-03 --to decode-eu-standby --drain 60s``
leo_runtime: started migration, draining connections. Expecting reduced OOMs in ~90s.
cs_jordan: which customers might be affected by throttle/clamp? Need list for CS/AE outreach.
amy_oncall: adding quick filter: clients with avg tokens > 2048 in last 1h and sending explicit high `max_tokens` -> will flag top 10.
ops-bot: Telemetry snippet (last 5m): ``OOM_count: 28, restarts: 12, request_drop_rate: 0.26``
maria_sre: created incident ticket INC-2026-3452, linking logs and flamegraphs.
raj_eng: root cause hypothesis: a recent client-facing SDK (v2.1.0) started forwarding `user_max_tokens` header unvalidated; router historically enforced model caps but a recent config override allowed header to win for certain routes. Combined with batching window extension (30ms->80ms) created large continuous KV allocations.
leo_runtime: mitigation checklist completed so far: router clamp applied, pool drained, fallback route to cpu-small-lm enabled for low-priority requests.
amy_oncall: confirm metrics: GPU mem usage on decode-eu-03 dropping now. ops-bot: current GPU mem usage snapshot: ``95% -> 42%``
amy_oncall: good. Initiating containment -> change to severity=P3, keep paged until postmortem.
cs_jordan: prepping customer note: "We applied temporary limits to maximum generation length to prevent request failures. If you see truncation, reach out and we'll whitelist your client after validation."
raj_eng: actionable follow-ups: 1) revert header-precedence change in router config 2) add unit/integration test to validate token cap enforcement 3) add telemetry alert when effective requested tokens > model_max * 1.2
maria_sre: suggested runbook edit: add explicit step to route long-request traffic to cpu fallback rather than batch coalescing.
leo_runtime: will push hotfix to router in canary: ``git rev: hotpatch/router-tokencap-20260317`` then promote.
amy_oncall: handing off to @maria_sre for post-containment monitoring and PM to follow for customer comms. 
maria_sre: taking over. I'll keep watch for 30m and then start RCA.
cs_jordan: will send interim CS updates to affected customers list once you confirm stable.
ops-bot: automation note: scheduled rollback job queued `rollback-80ms-batching-window` if we don't promote hotfix in 60m.
amy_oncall: thanks team. Short on-call summary for handoff: cause = header-vs-config token precedence + extended batching window -> KV explosion -> CUDA OOM -> container restarts -> request drops. Mitigations applied: router clamp, pool drain + migration, cpu fallback, queued hotfix and rollback. Status: stable, severity=P3.
maria_sre: adding timeline to ticket and tagging @postmortems.
leo_runtime: small note for postmortem: consider adaptive batch caps that refuse to coalesce requests with effective_token_estimate > X.
raj_eng: +1. Also we should add an integration test that simulates malicious/buggy clients setting insane max_tokens.
cs_jordan: will draft customer-safe messaging and coordinate with legal if any SLA notes required.
amy_oncall: I'll update the incident channel once hotfix is promoted. Good handoff. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-3452 updated with mitigation steps and owners.
